name: Schortens (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schortens (a red horse on white).
history: Municipal flag of Schortens; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schortens arms — red horse on white
